run_demo_inference: run the OpenPCDet demo to perform 3D object detection inference on point cloud data files
run_demo_visualization: run the demo script to visualize 3D bounding box predictions on point clouds using mayavi
create_DemoDataset: create a DemoDataset instance to load .bin or .npy point cloud files for inference
run_parse_config: run parse_config to load YAML model config and CLI args for the OpenPCDet demo
review_DemoDataset_getitem: review the DemoDataset __getitem__ method that loads point cloud data from .bin or .npy files
